about: The golden set for the search eval (M4). Each question names the corpus document (file name without .md) and an exact passage of it that answers the question. A search hit counts when a returned chunk from that document contains the passage. kind: words = shares its words with the passage; paraphrase = says it differently, with few or no shared words; identifier = holds an exact code or number. Written for this repo; the corpus is original text.
